[spoiler=[b]Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Trade between the Federal Republic of Hatorre and the Kingdom of Chimor[/b]

Tratado de Amistad, Cooperación y Comercio entre la República Federal de Hatorre y el Reino de Chimor
Hatorre Suyu Masinchikpaqa Chimor Sapa Qhapaq Suyuwan Suma Masinchay, Yanapanakuy, Qhatinchay Wakichikuq Rimay]
The Federal Republic of Hatorre and the Kingdom of Chimor are signing the following Trade, Friendship, and Cooperation Agreement between Hatorre and Chimor.

SECTION 1. FRIENDSHIP AGREEMENT
1. From this moment on, Hatorre and Chimor are friendly, sister nations and will establish full diplomatic relations, with respective ambassadors in Chanchán and Manzanilla.
2. Hatorre and Chimor sign a Non-Aggression Pact, by which the parties agree not to attack each other in future conflicts, which may be resolved through diplomatic channels. The Non-Aggression Pact is indissoluble, and a breach of the pact will be considered when one of the parties is deemed to be violating the sovereignty of the other through military occupation.
3. Hatorre and Chimor will sign a Defensive Agreement, in which the militaries of the two nations will cooperate in matters of defense and security, and, if necessary, support in times of conflict. Compliance with the requests of one party to the Defensive Agreement will be freely executed by the other party.
4. The Federal Republic of Hatorre recognizes the Kingdom of Chimor as a sovereign state, and the Kingdom of Chimor recognizes the Federal Republic of Hatorre as a sovereign state, as well as their respective territorial integrity, and they undertake to respect international law.

SECTION 2. COOPERATION AGREEMENT.
1. Hatorre and Chimor will cooperate in matters of education, health, security, economy, and trade, ensuring that the governments of both countries pursue common goals.
2. Hatorre and Chimor will allow visa-free travel for their citizens between the two countries, with only a passport required.
3. Hatorre and Chimor will allow ships from both countries to freely dock in their ports and waters.
4. Hatorre and Chimor will belong to the Conference of Vespurian States, a new political organization to ensure intercontinental dialogue and cooperation between countries.

SECTION 3. TRADE AGREEMENT
1. Hatorre will have priority import rights in Chimor, and Chimor will have priority import rights in Hatorre.
2. Hatorre will sell to the Kingdom of Chimor, for a renewable period of six months, 926 million barrels of crude oil at a price of US$5.93 billion.
3. Hatorre will sell to the Kingdom of Chimor, for a renewable period of one year, 30 tons of refined gold at a price of US$3,050 per ounce, for a total of US$3.27 billion.
4. Hatorre will sell to the Kingdom of Chimor, USD 2 billion in agricultural production each year, including rice, wheat, barley, onions, tomatoes, beans, turkey, strawberries, pumpkins, and seafood.
5. Chimor will sell to the Federal Republic of Hatorre, USD 2.4 billion in agricultural production each year, including potatoes and their local varieties, corn and its local varieties, and their derived products.

SECTION 4. INVESTMENT AGREEMENT
1. Hatorre will invest in the construction of a new commercial port in the capital city of Chanchán, with an investment of USD 4 billion, 10% of which will go to the Chimú Treasury. This new port, whose concession will be called Puerto Nueva Luz - Chanchán, will be managed by a Hatorrean holding company, and the fiscal policy with Chimor will be followed, with Chimor receiving 15% of the royalties from the profits. In 25 years, Chimor will have 55% control of the port concession.
2. Hatorre will invest in the creation and operation of seven mines in Chimú territory, under the control of five Hatorrean companies. These mines will be located in Farcsanga and Irmasanga. In Farcsanga, the mines will be dedicated to copper mining, and in Irmasanga, to lithium mining. The investment in these mines is US$25 billion, 11% of which will go to the Chimú Treasury. These seven mines will report their taxes according to Chimor's fiscal policy, and 12% of the profit royalties will be given to Chimor. In 20 years, Chimor will have 100% control of the Farcsanga mines and 60% of the Irmasanga mines.
3. Hatorre will invest in a natural gas production plant to be located in southern Chansanga. The initial investment is USD 9 billion, and 9% will be donated to the Chimú Treasury. The natural gas plant will report its taxes, and 17% of the profit royalties will go to Chimor. In 30 years, Chimor will own 50% of the plant.
4. Hatorre will respect local Chimor laws regarding tax and business policy, as well as the labor code.
5. Hatorre will respect the environment through non-polluting techniques in its mining operations, such as water reuse in lithium exploitation.
6. Hatorre will ensure that the vast majority of employees in these investments are citizens of the Kingdom of Chimor.
7. Hatorre will be attentive to any concerns that Chimor may have as a result of the investments and will ensure compliance with and protection of the investments.

SECTION 5. FINAL PROVISIONS.
1. This treaty is indissoluble for all parties, unless both parties decide to dissolve it.
2. This treaty shall be the basis for any future diplomatic agreements between Chimor and Hatorre.

Signed,

[b]SEBASTIÁN ESPINOSA DE LOS MONTEROS[/b], President of the Federal Republic of Hatorre
[i]Sapa[/i] [b]CHUMUN CAUR[/b], Emperor of Chimor[/spoiler]
